machine.title: Line machine
machine.name: Machine name
machine.noMachine: This line has no machine yet. Create it first - modules and feeders are added by the first Excel import or below.
machine.requireSlotScan: Require feeder sticker scan after the reel
machine.requireSlotScanHint: Off: the station shows where the reel goes (like the old model-changer). On: the operator must also scan the feeder sticker - use only with scanners set to centering/picklist mode, feeder positions are very close together.

import.title: Import feeder setup
import.hint: Excel with columns Module | Feeder | Code (as in the old model-changer). Code can be a part number, an RCode or a scanned reel QR. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
import.unreadableFile: The file could not be read
import.emptyFile: No rows found in the file
import.headerNotDetected: Header row not recognized - reading columns A, B, C as Module, Feeder, Code.
import.selectLineAndModel: Select the line and model to check the file.
import.fixErrors: Fix the red rows in the Excel file and choose it again.

issues.MissingValue: Module, feeder or code is empty
issues.AmbiguousCode: Part number belongs to several components - use the RCode
issues.NoMachine: This line has no machine yet - create it on the Line machine page.

detail.activateMessage: It becomes the setup operators verify against on this line. The currently active version is archived.
detail.deleteMessage: The draft and its feeder list are removed. Feeders created by the import stay on the machine.

diff.firstVersion: First version - nothing to compare with

station.pickLineHint: The station opens full-screen. On the line PC you can bookmark it directly.
station.noSetups: This line has no active feeder setup. Import one and activate it.
station.nowScanSlot: Put the reel there and scan the feeder sticker
station.rescanSlot: Move the reel and scan the feeder sticker again
station.scanReelFirst: Scan the reel first, then the feeder sticker
station.putReelHere: Put the reel into this feeder, then scan the next reel
station.slotScanOff: Feeder sticker scanning is off for this line - just scan the next reel

ngReasons.NotInSetup: This component is not in this model
ngReasons.NoActiveSetup: Setup changed - select the model again
